narrative.details:
Eager for work, I see.  Lucky for you a day never goes by that I don't wish I had a fledgling champion to perform my bidding.

You see, adventurer, I can make you very happy and provide you with things you never dreamed of having.  But in order for that to happen you must bring me certain items.

My business in the forest often requires certain. . .reagents.  Fetch for me 3 Nightsaber Fangs, 3 Strigid Owl Feathers and 3 swatches of Webwood Spider Silk.

Let's keep this our little secret, friend.
narrative.objectives: Bring Zenn Foulhoof outside of Dolanaar 3 Nightsaber Fangs, 3 Strigid Owl Feathers and 3 swatches of Webwood Spider Silk.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ha ha! Well, done indeed.

Who would have ever guessed that I, Zenn Foulhoof, would have a friend to do my bidding? Certainly not me! But so it goes... this beloved world of ours is full of surprises.

Three cheers for the naive and gullible!
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you been a busy little bee, adventurer? I've been waiting for you to bring me what I need.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 5 to 7, 1,075 XP in all.
